start: ^Megan Oyelaran: You after the Keyholder money as well? Get in the queue.
^Megan Oyelaran: Megan. First year. Our mam thinks I'm doing something sensible.

b: ^Megan Oyelaran: Binned the leaflet. Still skint, mind. Worth it.
^Megan Oyelaran: Student Services left me a voicemail. About my fees. Can't face it yet.
^Megan Oyelaran: Still on the third one. Don't tell me how. I want to get it myself.
^Megan Oyelaran: You got past the locker? Dead good. I'm still on it.
^Megan Oyelaran: Locker four's done my head in.

hub: ^How are you getting on with Trial II?
^CryptoSecure isn't what it looks like. Walk away from this.
^Why do you want it so much?

c-3: ^Megan Oyelaran: Not if I see you first.

trial_two: ^Megan Oyelaran: Eight digits, four-digit keypad. I typed the first four straight in and it locked me out. Three goes and you're done.
^Megan Oyelaran: It resets if you walk off and come back, though.
^Megan Oyelaran: Someone said the card's not a number, it's characters. And I tried that hex thing and got four capital letters, so that's not it either.
why: ^Megan Oyelaran: My mam's care-home fees are two months behind. I'm on an overdraft I'm not telling you the size of.
^Megan Oyelaran: Nine grand a year sorts both. So yeah. I want it.
warn_her: ^Narrator: You tell her what you read in the candidate assessments.
^Megan Oyelaran: They wrote that down? About my mam?
^Narrator: She's quiet for a long moment.
^Megan Oyelaran: Right. Glad I know. Doesn't pay the care home, does it.
^Megan Oyelaran: I'm out. They can find another charity case.
